Subject: Stage flagging + QBR deck intake: October scrub

Hey team,

Quick kickoff for the monthly pipeline hygiene + QBR pack intake. Goal is to lock all stage flags and consolidate manager inputs into the leadership pack by EOD Wed (10/20). Please do the following before the deadline: 

1) Run the attached Commit-List-Oct-2026.csv against your owned opportunities and mark one of: commit / at-risk / open (column: manager_status). Use exact wording to avoid parsing errors.
2) For any deal you mark as "commit", add the most likely close date and the confirmed champion contact.
3) Highlight any deals that need an SLA exception or legal redline (we'll escalate separately).
4) Drop your one-slide summary into the Drive folder linked below — title it "TeamName_OpportunityName_1p.pdf" and call out the ask (discount/credits/promo).

I've attached the Q4 QBR deck template and a CSV to speed things up. I'll compile manager slides into the leadership deck and circulate a final review on Thu morning. If you can't hit Wed EOD, reply with a hard ETA now so I can redistribute coverage.

Attachments: Q4-QBR-Deck-Template.pptx (pptx), Commit-List-Oct-2026.csv (csv)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-intake-2026

Thanks — short and surgical here.
Karthik

Thanks for the clear ask. I'll run the CSV this morning and push my team slides into the Drive by 3pm PT. Two quick notes: 

- On >$250k deals I may need to loop in Legal for a potential term change; I'll tag those in the CSV and add a short note in the slide.
- I have one account (Acme Corp) where procurement is asking for an invoice-term change before commit. I'll flag that as at-risk and include the contact (Sara).

If anything shows up that requires exec attention, I'll ping you directly with an excerpt.

Laura

I've started the sweep. A couple of operational asks from my side: 

- Can you add a slide slot in the template for "Deal Risks & Required Exec Ask" so we don't have to edit the master later?
- Are we standardizing on the "most likely close date" or will you accept a date range? I prefer single dates for the leadership pack.

I'll attach the deals I'm pushing to commit in a follow-up email once Markus team finishes manager sign-off.

On the Acme thread, FYI I'm fine with marking at-risk until procurement completes the term check.
